subject.title: feat(agents): default code mode to per-model auto activation

question: Should existing users who omit `tools.codeMode.enabled` begin using code mode automatically for catalog-preferred models on upgrade?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally changing the shipped behavior of an existing omitted configuration, and the PR’s assertion of an owner decision is not independently established by the supplied maintainer discussion.

options.title: Confirm automatic default
options.body: Approve the upgrade behavior after adding real omitted-config proof that preferred models engage and unpreferred models retain the normal tool surface.

options.title: Keep opt-in default
options.body: Retain `false` as the shipped default and expose automatic activation only through explicit configuration or a separately approved rollout path.

recommendation.title: Confirm automatic default
recommendation.body: Approve the upgrade behavior after adding real omitted-config proof that preferred models engage and unpreferred models retain the normal tool surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged prerequisite and this follow-up both place the preferred-model policy and default decision in this area of ownership.
